tests.case: quiets dots at and below each watermark while keeping newer dots and timeline marks unread

UpdateFlagTests.The_dots_quiet_at_or_bel.reason: Both surfaces preserve inclusive release watermarks, unread rows and patch counts. The current visual specification retains acknowledged history as neutral timeline marks instead of removing it; only unread marks retain Flare.

tests.case: quiets the later announcement with its dismissed push and preserves the newer pair

UpdateFlagTests.The_announcement_that_co.reason: The shared desktop/fullscreen projection correlates announcements with their own release pushes.

tests.case: describes a fully read gap without claiming that nothing shipped

UpdateFlagTests.A_fully_read_gap_says_so.reason: Both surfaces preserve the source caption and extinguish unread dots and timeline Flare; neutral historical marks remain per the current visual specification.

tests.case: preserves undismissed dots and counts patches rather than their two observations

UpdateFlagTests.An_undismissed_gap_is_un.reason: Both surfaces retain the source caption, every unread observation and the correlated patch count.

tests.case: dismisses the dots offers undo and refreshes the library once while preserving the timeline range

UpdateFlagTests.Dismissing_quiets_the_do.reason: Confirmed acknowledgements update the shared details cache and refresh library queries once for the batch.

tests.case: leaves failed writes unread with no receipt no undo and no library refresh

UpdateFlagTests.A_failed_store_shows_no_.reason: A definite NotStored response retains reading state and the source failure copy without a success receipt or library invalidation.

tests.case: restores a standing dismissal and raises the flag for %s

UpdateFlagTests.A_standing_dismissal_off.reason: Stored and already-revoked responses clear the standing watermark and restore unread presentation on both surfaces.

tests.case: offers dismissal again when a newer push outranks the standing watermark

UpdateFlagTests.A_newer_push_over_a_stan.reason: Unread pushes above a standing acknowledgement offer dismissal without offering the stale undo.

tests.case: offers no write controls without the named service bridge

UpdateFlagTests.With_no_service_the_cont.reason: The Electron equivalent of service availability is its named preload request bridge; a read-only preview without it offers no write control. Production registers the backend flag service.

tests.case: does not count marketing or notes for a push exactly at last play

UpdateFlagTests.Marketing_and_notes_for_.reason: The source strict last-play boundary and uncorrelated-announcement behavior are asserted in both surfaces.

tests.case: does not extend the watermark through shared notes over a newer build

UpdateFlagTests.Correlated_notes_do_not_.reason: One announcement may corroborate two builds without acknowledging the newer one.

update flags retain partial saves retry remaining releases and restore both editions

UpdateFlagTests.A_partially_saved_group_.reason: Confirmed release watermarks remain visible after a partial refusal; subsequent acknowledgement captures only the remaining unread release on desktop and fullscreen.
